## History

Henry was mistreated by his uncle Tom and aunt from an early age, suffering severe starvation and frequent beatings. His uncle regularly thrashed him in the garden behind their house to avoid being seen by neighbors. As a result of this abuse, Henry developed epilepsy and grew up simple until he reached the age of eighteen.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P9](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0009), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P10](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0010), +35 more_
